title: Wayfare Pass Membership Terms — Schedule of Entry Requirements and Free Trials
content:
# Schedule of entry requirements and free trials (Wayfare Pass)

This schedule sets, plan by plan, what a customer needs to hold a Wayfare Pass (rider membership) plan, how long a first-time member's free trial lasts, and which plans a card partner offer can provide.

## Entry requirements

| Plan | Minimum age | Student enrollment verified | Payment card on file |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Pass Student | 18 | required | required |
| Wayfare Pass Monthly | 18 | not required | required |
| Wayfare Pass Annual | 18 | not required | required |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly | 18 | not required | required |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Annual | 18 | not required | required |
| Wayfare Pass All Access Annual | 18 | not required | required |

## Free trial and card partner terms

| Plan | Free trial length (calendar days) | Trial lookback (calendar months) | All plan benefits during the trial | A card partner offer can provide this plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Pass Student | 30 | 12 | yes | no |
| Wayfare Pass Monthly | 30 | 12 | yes | yes |
| Wayfare Pass Annual | 30 | 12 | yes | yes |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly | 14 | 12 | yes | no |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Annual | 14 | 12 | yes | yes |
| Wayfare Pass All Access Annual | 0 | 12 | yes | no |

## Meaning of the columns

1. **Free trial length** is the length of the free trial for a first-time member, in calendar days counting the enrollment date as day 1; a length of 0 means the plan has no trial.
2. **Trial lookback** is the window, in calendar months, for the rule that no trial is granted if the customer held any Wayfare Pass membership that began within this many calendar months before enrollment.
3. **All plan benefits during the trial** states whether all plan benefits apply during the free trial.
4. **A card partner offer can provide this plan** states, per plan, whether a card partner offer can provide it.

## Hypothetical counting examples

- A 30-day trial on a membership enrolled on 5 May: 5 May is day 1, so day 30, the trial's last day, is 3 June.
- A 14-day trial on a membership enrolled on 5 May: day 14, the trial's last day, is 18 May.
- Wayfare Pass All Access Annual has a trial length of 0, so it has no free trial.
